findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "connect" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_order, get_order · Private data: create_order · Public sink: create_order, get_order.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_order, get_order · Private data: create_order · Public sink: create_order, get_order

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
